text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are holding steady near recent levels with minimal intraday movement, while altcoins show modest weakness, suggesting cautious consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 63 (Greed) with a declining 7-day trend indicates sentiment is cooling from overbought conditions despite remaining above neutral. Bitcoin's dominance at 58.2% paired with $51B daily volume reflects moderate engagement—enough liquidity to support prices but not the aggressive capital inflow typically seen during strong rallies.
